checklist.item: candidate は confirmed/pass/readiness complete、全 depends_on done、active lease なしを満たす
checklist.evidence: ready_set.tasks = [LT-SCHED-001, LT-SCHED-002, LT-SCHED-003, LT-SCHED-006]. All 4 have status=active, confirmation_status=confirmed, evaluation_status=pass, implementation_readiness.status=complete, no unsatisfied depends_on, and no active lease. LT-SCHED-004 excluded by active lease. LT-SCHED-005 excluded by dependency_unsatisfied.

checklist.item: feature ready と task ready が別々の ready-set/batch に出力される
checklist.evidence: ready_set.features=[], ready_set.tasks=[LT-SCHED-001,002,003,006]. batches.features=[], batches.tasks=[[001,003],[002,006]]. No mixing. All nodes are artifact_kind=task so features are empty.

checklist.item: 同一 parallel batch の resource_scope.touches 重複 pair が0件である
checklist.evidence: batch[0]: LT-SCHED-001(src/alpha.py) + LT-SCHED-003(src/beta.py) → intersection empty. batch[1]: LT-SCHED-002(src/alpha.py) + LT-SCHED-006(src/delta.py) → intersection empty. LT-SCHED-001 and LT-SCHED-002 share src/alpha.py but are in separate batches.

checklist.item: 各 task の suggested_branch が devgraph/<graph_node_id> で claim command が public CLI 形式である
checklist.evidence: 4 assignment_hints with unique suggested_branch: devgraph/LT-SCHED-001, devgraph/LT-SCHED-002, devgraph/LT-SCHED-003, devgraph/LT-SCHED-006. Each has claim_command: /dev-graph worktree claim <id> --branch devgraph/<id> --session-id <session>.

checklist.item: 実行前後の graph/tracker/lease digest が同一である
lease pathがgit common-dirの正本と一致する
checklist.evidence: lease_source=git_common_dir. Path .git/dev-graph/leases.json matches git rev-parse --git-common-dir canonical path.

checklist.item: LT-SCHED-005 が dependency_unsatisfied で ready-set から除外される
checklist.evidence: unmapped contains {external_ref: LT-SCHED-005, reason: dependency_unsatisfied, blocking_depends_on: [LT-SCHED-001], source: schedule-graph}. LT-SCHED-001 has status=active (not done), so dependency is unsatisfied.

observations.description: the overlapping resource_scope pair is never placed in the same batch
observations.evidence: LT-SCHED-001 and LT-SCHED-002 both touch src/alpha.py. They appear in conflict_pairs[0] as ready_pair. batch[0]=[001,003], batch[1]=[002,006] — never co-located.

observations.description: the blocked task is excluded from the ready set and the reason is reported
observations.evidence: LT-SCHED-005 depends_on LT-SCHED-001 (status=active, not done). Excluded from ready_set. Reported in unmapped with reason=dependency_unsatisfied, blocking_depends_on=[LT-SCHED-001].

observations.description: the active lease suppresses its task while the stale lease is reclaimed
observations.evidence: LT-SCHED-004: active lease (in_progress, expires 2099) → conflicts=[LT-SCHED-004], excluded from ready set. LT-SCHED-006: stale lease (claimed, expires 2020) → reclaimed, included in ready_set and batch[1].

observations.description: batches respect --max-parallel and suggested_branch and worktree claim commands stay unique
observations.evidence: max_parallel=2. batch[0] has 2 tasks, batch[1] has 2 tasks. All 4 suggested_branch values are unique (devgraph/LT-SCHED-001, -002, -003, -006). All claim_commands are unique.
